about: The cancel step's letter-slip rule. Frozen before this comparison; nothing here was tuned on it.

keepFirstPerLetter.meaning: keep the mark if the expected word scores at or below this per letter on the first pass
keepFirstPerLetter.source: letter-slip experiment, QuranMB marks, professional false marks and W1 marks, none of them held out

keepGap.meaning: keep the mark if a spelling with one inner letter changed beats the written word by at least this, in the padded look

marginSeconds.meaning: the padded look takes the word and this much either side
marginSeconds.source: the same experiment: the cut that separated marks best

silenceSeconds.meaning: digital silence added each side of the padded look
silenceSeconds.source: the same experiment: a choice, not varied
